body:
What a great taste. Far more pleasant than other teas.
Great to relax. Great for bed (3 bags is nice).
Smoking doesnt seem to do anything, tastes like shit, and is harsh.
Maybe this is just me but, I have no craving what-so-ever to smoke a cig when consuming chamomile..weird.
This along with valerian root would be a great sleep aid (not that IT (chamomile) isn't already.
Love this tea..
